title: LibRPA defaults to symmetry off, so aligning to an archived symmetry = -1 input silently costs the whole full-BZ q loop
symptom: The Si 8x8x8 G0W0 case (44 bands, 794 auxiliary functions) ran with ABACUS symmetry -1 and use_symmetry_exx/gw = f. Every gate passed: the two sides were consistent. The stage then spent ~14 min per frequency time grid in chi0, twice, and projected 15-18 h on a full node, because chi0/Wc loop over 512 q instead of the IBZ.
root_cause: The LibRPA binary defaults are use_symmetry_exx/gw/rpa = OFF, and ABACUS's own default symmetry = 1 is what the archived record overrides with -1. The oml symmetry gate only verified consistency (ABACUS symmetry matches use_symmetry_*), so a self-consistent symmetry-off lane looked like a pass, and the archived record's -1 was copied into the case as if it were a requirement rather than a choice with a 15x price. Symmetry is the single largest cost switch in the pipeline.
minimal_fix: Treat symmetry as a production default that is ON (use_symmetry in the review card), and treat 'off' as a deviation that must be acknowledged with a reason: the gate now warns with the concrete q counts (8x8x8: 512 q versus roughly 20-30 IBZ q), and the review card lists use_symmetry=false as a deviation. When symmetry is on, keep the full-BZ PyATB products in input_dir (the star-expansion lane reads them); when it is off, keep them out (their presence overrides LibRPA's own head term).
validation: With symmetry on, the LibRPA log reports the IBZ q count instead of 512, the chi0/Wc phases shrink by about the star factor, and bands.qp_correction still passes - the star-overcount failure mode of this lane is exactly what that gate watches.
avoid: Do not copy an archived symmetry = -1 input without asking whether the record needed the full-q control lane; do not treat 'both sides say off' as evidence that symmetry should be off.
source: run-20261028T091941Z-4217995169 (symmetry off, ~14 min per chi0 time grid, projected 15-18 h) versus the same case relaunched as si-k888-sg15-g0w0-sym; binary defaults in src/api/options.cpp.

parameters.use_symmetry: production default on; off is a reviewable deviation
